name: die Kantine
kurzbeschreibung: The **Kantine in Mieders** – a cozy spot where you can enjoy hearty Austrian dishes in a rustic setting. Try the **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy pancake torn into pieces and served with apple compote, or savor traditional **Tiroler Gröstl**, a crispy potato and bacon hash. The warm atmosphere and local flavors make it the perfect place to recharge after a day of exploring the **Inntal** or the **Karwendel** mountains.
